title: Dynamo
description: A library that enables the creation of multi-loader mods
body:
# Dynamo

Dynamo is the official implementation of [Stator](https://github.com/Ramixin/stator) designed for making multiloader modding as easy as possible.

## Found an issue?

Please report the issue to the corresponding repository:

| Loader   | Repository                                 |
|----------|--------------------------------------------|
| Fabric   | https://github.com/Ramixin/dynamo-fabric   |
| NeoForge | https://github.com/Ramixin/dynamo-neoforge |

## How To Use

For players, download the correct version for the correct loader right here on Modrith.

For developers, see the github repository README.md for details on using Dynamo in modding environments.
